lines.en: All night I wait for you to return,

lines.cyr: да ме љубиш, да ме милуваш,
lines.lat: da me ljubiš, da me miluvaš,
lines.en: to kiss me, to caress me,

lines.cyr: а ти седиш в' пусти меани,
lines.lat: a ti sediš v' pusti meani,
lines.en: and you sit in empty taverns,
Come, dear, come and kiss me,
this night will pass, it will pass quickly,
these lips of mine are unpoured wine,

lines.cyr: вино што врие, што ќе те опие.
lines.lat: vino što vrie, što ḱe te opie.
lines.en: wine that ferments, that will make you drunk.
Leave the company and the taverns,
the wine ferments and will finish fermenting,

lines.cyr: сал мојво срце не ќе прегори.
lines.lat: sal mojvo srce ne ḱe pregori.
lines.en: only this heart of mine will not burn out.
Come, dear, come and kiss me,
this night will pass, it will pass quickly,
these lips of mine are unpoured wine,

lines.cyr: вино што врие, што ќе те опие.
lines.lat: vino što vrie, što ḱe te opie.
lines.en: wine that ferments, that will make you drunk.
